subject.title: feat(control-ui): drag sessions into split view with animated drop preview

question: Should Control UI accept this full sidebar-session drag-and-drop split-view model once the proof and merge-state blockers are fixed?
rationale: This PR defines a new user-facing workspace composition interaction on a protected maintainer-labeled feature, so automation should not choose the permanent UX contract alone.

options.title: Sponsor After Proof
options.body: Accept the feature direction, then require real browser behavior proof and a clean merge result before merge.

options.title: Narrow The Gesture
options.body: Ask for a smaller first version, such as center replacement or right-split only, before owning animated four-edge zones.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Keep the existing header-button and pane selector workflow if the drag/drop complexity is not worth maintaining now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction, then require real browser behavior proof and a clean merge result before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest product context from the split-view foundation and the canonical follow-up request.
